problem.symptom: Google OAuth could still strand a retry on root state_mismatch after duplicate-cookie normalization.
problem.probableCause: The previous callback normalizer only rewrote duplicate state cookies when one cookie matched the callback state; missing-cookie or purely stale-cookie callbacks still fell through to Better Auth.

behavior.matchingStateCookie: Forward callback to the main app Worker with duplicate Better Auth OAuth state cookies reduced to the cookie matching the callback state.
behavior.missingOrStaleStateCookie: Redirect to /login?next=/workshop&error=state_mismatch and expire Better Auth OAuth state cookie variants across host-only/domain and likely callback paths.

deploymentReadback.command: bunx wrangler deployments list --name archestimator-auth-callback-normalizer -c wrangler.auth-callback-normalizer.jsonc --json

rootStateMismatchCleanup.redirectGap: Current Wrangler OAuth token has zone:read but not the zone-write permission needed for Cloudflare Redirect Rules.

watchItems: Keep the callback normalizer route active until the main Worker source fix is live and verified.
Complete a real Google account-selection proof after the user retries from the cleaned login surface.
Add a Cloudflare Redirect Rule for root ?error=state_mismatch only after zone-write permission is available, if automatic root retry redirect is still desired.
Add hosted auth cookie fixtures if allowed/denied/revoked/expired route cases should run without browser interaction.
